title: AFL Grand Final Live and Loud at The Conti
summary: The Continental Sorrento screens the 2026 AFL Grand Final across the Conti Bar, beer garden and promenade. Saturday 26 September, free entry.
nearbyAttractions: Sorrento front beach; Sorrento main street
suggestedItineraryPairing: Grand Final at the Conti, then dinner in Sorrento
editorVerdict: Big screens, a beer garden and no ticket. The obvious plan if you are down this end for the last Saturday in September.
editorNote:
The Conti puts the Grand Final across the Conti Bar, the beer garden and the promenade, from the pre-game build up to the final siren.

Free entry and no booking listed, so it works as a walk-in. Get there early if you want a table in the garden rather than a spot at the rail.
